description:
You are a Systems Engineer at SmartGrow. You need to create a standardized custom component library for the company's IoT hardware and use it to create a deployment diagram.

Your tasks:
1. Open the device specifications file at '~/Desktop/device_specs.txt' to read the visual requirements.
2. In draw.io, create two custom composite symbols according to the specs:
   - 'SoilProbe-X1': A green vertical rectangle body with a brown triangle tip. These MUST be GROUPED together.
   - 'Hub-Gateway-Z': A blue square body with a white circle antenna and red status LED. These MUST be GROUPED together.
3. Create a New Library named 'SmartGrow Devices' (File > New Library) and save it to '~/Diagrams/SmartGrow_Lib.xml'.
4. Add your two grouped symbols to this library.
5. Create a new diagram named 'field_deployment.drawio' in '~/Diagrams/'.
6. Use your new library symbols to draw a deployment topology: One Hub connected to three Soil Probes.
7. Connect the devices with arrows.
8. Save everything.

IMPORTANT: The symbols must be actual GROUPS (Select shapes > Right click > Group), not just loose shapes placed near each other. Handle any update dialogs by clicking Cancel.
